decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 14, 15a, 028-01 Rev B, 028-02, 028-03, 028-10 Rev F, 028-11 Rev B, 028-12 Rev C, 028-13, Design and Access Statement. Received: 23rd March 2016 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the parking space shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No.028-10 Rev F received: 23rd March 2016 and such space shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and shall thereafter be retained as such.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  flank walls or roofslope of the extension or existing building hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The window formed in the east elevation of the two storey extension (shown as serving bedroom 4) and the existing window in the east flank wall (shown as serving kitchen/dining room) on plan number 028-10 Rev F received 23rd March 2016 shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 8 - No development shall begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the retail use and the residential house in multiple occupation above, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the occupation and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 9 - The storage area as shown on drawing no. 028-01 Rev B and hereby permitted shall be used only for storage ancillary to the retail use of the premises and not for any other purpose (including as a separate retail unit or any purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any order revoking or re-enacting that order).

Condition : 10 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of bicycles have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for the storing of bicycles shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and shall thereafter be retained as such.
description: Relocation of an external staircase, erection of a two storey side extension, alterations to the main roof to create a fully hipped roof and a rear roof extension with 2 roof windows to front elevation, to create residential accommodation comprising of 4no. double occupancy rooms and 2no. single occupancy rooms, with associated facilities.
